title: Oath of the Broken Fleet
terms: Recover the Ancestor Core, avenge the Durn Prospect Fleet, and protect the Hold.
reward_text: The Hold's gratitude, measured in how well the oath is kept.
penalty_text: This oath cannot be broken. How well you keep it shapes the ending.

title: Debt to Kaptin Snazrik
terms: Pay 60 Ore for the freebooters' covering fire at Kethra's Anvil.
penalty_text: Snazrik remembers bad ones better. Reputation loss and a grudge.

title: Debt to a Hernkyn tow
terms: Repay 30 Ore for the emergency fuel.
reward_text: Word gets around that you pay your debts.
penalty_text: Word gets around that you don't.

title: Oath of mutual defence with Kharr
terms: Stand with Kharr against the Orks, as Kharr will stand with you.
penalty_text: A sworn oath before the ancestors cannot be broken.

title: Pact with Boss Urgrot
terms: When the Waaagh! comes, back Urgrot's challenge against Skragnak. He will turn his ships on Skragnak in return.
reward_text: An Ork civil war at the worst possible moment for Skragnak.
penalty_text: Break it, and Urgrot becomes a grudge of his own.

title: Contract: medicae for Durnvar
terms: Deliver 2 sealed medicae crates to Hold Durnvar.
penalty_text: The guild will tell everyone you let wounded Kin go without.

title: Contract: Ork scrap for the forges
terms: Bring 3 loads of Ork scrap to Karrak Station.
penalty_text: The forge-masters will be disappointed. Loudly.

title: Bounty: the Red Tally
terms: Disable the freebooter cutter Red Tally, last seen in the Grimholt Belt.
penalty_text: The bounty goes to someone else.

title: Contract: Snazrik's crate
terms: Carry one sealed crate to Karrak Station. Do not open it.
penalty_text: Snazrik does not forgive lost cargo.
